Use case: stylized-concept / lighting-weather.
Asset: one standalone square 1:1 full-bleed NURI pet-app weather hero illustration, not a mockup, grid, collage, contact sheet or UI.
STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: the supplied autumn image sets the polished color quality, tactile animated-film 3D rendering, fine soft fluffy fur, rounded charming forms, clear natural eyes, believable wood/glass/water/materials and beautiful light. Do not copy its maple-tree terrace, river vista, seated lineup, animal placements or camera composition. Create the requested seasonal setting as a genuinely new illustration. The animals must be recognizable real species, not human-like mascots. No human, human body parts, humanoids, clothes on animals, giant cartoon eyes, typography, watermark, border or baked gradient band.
Ensemble: all eleven individually recognizable companions, with natural relative proportions and coherent anatomy: fluffy golden retriever; round gray-white cat; cream lop-eared rabbit; tiny golden hamster; caramel-white guinea pig; slender sable ferret with dark mask; yellow-green budgerigar; orange goldfish inside a stable spacious planted glass aquarium filled with water; patterned land tortoise; warm-yellow spotted leopard gecko with a clearly visible tail; small hedgehog with fine spines. Dog and cat are visual anchors; little species remain clearly visible without forming a catalog lineup. Show affectionate natural interactions and some three-quarter faces. No additional animals. Fish never outside water. Cold-sensitive pets remain dry in a cozy protected sunroom or shelter, bird inside/on protected warm perch and reptiles on warm protected ledges; never show tropical pets freezing, immersed in snow or ocean, or drenched.
Mobile hero framing: preserve a calm, mostly uniform OPEN SKY area in the upper-left roughly 42% of width and 43% of height, with no heads, canopy, moon, lantern or busy foliage there. This area will carry app temperature and district later, but draw NO TEXT. For day, keep it softly light blue/gray; for night, softly medium-dark blue. Animal faces and bodies sit mainly across the middle from 44% to 78% image height, entirely above the bottom 18% fade zone. Bottom 18% is quiet ground, paving, sand or snow with low contrast and no important faces, suitable for later app blending. Do not crop animals or turn the entire image into a pale wash. Rich balanced natural hues, readable faces even at night, refined premium and cute without clutter.

Seasonal scene:
WINTER: a new snow-covered alpine cottage garden and snowy pine hills, not autumn leaves and not the autumn river terrace. Crisp powdery snowbanks, snow-dusted evergreen trees, icy blue distant peaks and one cozy rounded glass conservatory on the RIGHT. An energetic golden retriever bounds lightly through the snow while the cat watches/playfully reaches from the sheltered threshold; the rabbit and small mammals nestle near warm cushions inside the open-front protected conservatory with the bird, planted aquarium and warm reptile nook visible. Playful snow-day atmosphere, not a motion-blurred dog. Warm honey window light contrasts with ice-blue snow. A few delicate pawprints; no people, ski equipment or snowman. Left sky stays empty. Every variant remains unmistakably winter.

Weather and light:
CLEAR DAY: bright clear daylight and a few soft distant clouds. No precipitation, no falling snowflakes, no rain streaks, no moon or stars. WINTER only: existing snow on the ground is normal, but no active snowfall. Gentle natural sunlight, light blue calm copy sky, detailed soft shadows and rich balanced seasonal colors.
